content: Dexie.js 4 full-replace transaction pattern: db.transaction('rw', db.medicines, db.locations, db.history, async () => { await db.medicines.clear(); await db.locations.clear(); await db.history.clear(); await db.medicines.bulkAdd(records); await db.locations.bulkAdd(records); await db.history.bulkAdd(records); }). bulkAdd() inside a transaction: if uncaught error throws, entire transaction rolls back. bulkAdd(items, keys?, {allKeys}) returns promise to last key. Only use native Promises inside transactions. IndexedDB commits on next tick if unused — keep all DB ops sequential with await.
